主题：Disciplinary Action Privacy Standard
Reminder: disciplinary matters are confidential under our HR privacy standard. Notifications must be sent only to the recipients listed in the progressive discipline policy (manager, HR director, legal, CEO as applicable). Do NOT post any disciplinary action — employee names, issues, or outcomes — to team Slack channels like #hr-general. The broader HR team is informed via monthly aggregate reports, not per-case Slack posts.

- HR Director"}
